datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators across Chad on a monthly basis (January, April, July, October 2014). Geographic polygons with IPC phase classifications represent food insecurity impact assessments, with metadata including collection dates, scenarios, and assistance eligibility flags.
